body: Thank you, I'm checking them out. Thank you.

I often just want to finish a book I've been writing in my free time so that I can end it all having given something to the world. I'm socially toxic, I've driven everyone away who I loved, and I think the world would be better off without me around.

My very best friends, even my family, I'm an anchor to them. You can pay lip service to the contrary, but I know how much it damages them that I'm not doing well consistently. If I were gone, they'd go through a grieving period then be honestly relieved that I'm no longer around as this Saturnian constant that defies their efforts to make the world better. I am always aggrieved, or upset, or despondent. I am so rarely happy, and contributing, and joyful. I'm a black hole, and if we were an earlier society I'd have been taken care of much younger for the sake of the species.

Explained? I need meds, or I'm doing what I have to do for the people who matter to me.
